signals.text: I wear 3XL. . .  good fit, comfortable, but for the sweatshirt, I could have also wear a 4XL. . . . just a little more room, but I like a little bigger . . . .

Bought these for my 3 and 6 year grandsons to wear in a neighborhood christmas parade.  They were perfect.  And the boys were perfectly warm too!  Win/Win.  Washed up nicely.  Paired with some cute elf hats and the look was complete.  Since they are 3 and 6 gramma got away with it... but I think next year the 6 year old will probably not "agree" to be so cute.  Hahaha
Very soft light sweatshirt great for cool Summer nights
